backups.asked: Export asked for. It is taken on the host's next tick; refresh to see it.
backups.intro: A `pg_dump` of the whole database, as a download link that lasts a few hours.
backups.newProject: The restore goes into a NEW project beside this one, never over it, so a wrong guess costs nothing. It uses one of your plan's project slots.
backups.noBackup: There is no backup to restore from yet. The first one is taken shortly after the project is created.
backups.pitr: Restore to a point in time
backups.pitrPlan: Point-in-time restore is part of the Pro and Business plans, and this project is on {tier}.
backups.restoring: Restoring into a new project, {name} ({ref}). It is added to your connections.
backups.windowFail: The restore window could not be read.

conn.afterReset: After a reset, the old password works
conn.apiIntro: For `@snoutdata/client` and the data API, at `https://{ref}.api.snoutdata.com`. The server key bypasses row-level security: keep it on a server.
conn.copied: {label} copied. Reading it is recorded on the project's activity log.
conn.keysBody: Both keys are replaced. Every key already pasted into an app, a deployment or a CI secret stops working.
conn.resetGrace: The new password comes with a new user name. The old password keeps working for {grace}, so other apps can pick up the new one. Your connections in this app are updated now.
conn.resetHint: A reset puts the new password on the project's other owner login, so the user name changes too. Until the old password stops, apps still holding it keep connecting.
conn.resetNow: The old password stops working at once and connections that signed in with it are ended. Your connections in this app are updated to the new user name and password.
conn.title: Connection
conn.tls: TLS is required. The password is stored for you and goes straight to the clipboard.

ctr.allowanceCpu: {deployed} of {max} deployed, {mb} MB and {cpu}% of a core each
ctr.builtFor: Built for linux/arm64. The tag is resolved once, now, and that exact image runs until the next deploy.
ctr.builtMsg: {name} is built and deployed. The host starts it within a minute.
ctr.deployedMsg: {name} is deployed. The host pulls it and starts it within a minute.
ctr.ephemeral: Anything written inside a container is lost when it restarts or is redeployed. Keep what matters in your database.
ctr.folderIntro: Builds the folder's Dockerfile for linux/arm64 with the Docker on this computer, uploads it to this project, and runs it. Nothing is built on our side, so Docker must be running here.
ctr.intro: Your own image, running beside this project for as long as it runs, with `DATABASE_URL`, `PORT` and the project's secrets in its environment.
ctr.noLog: Nothing printed yet. Lines arrive about once a minute.
ctr.none: This project runs no container yet. Deploy one below.
ctr.notCopied: The address could not be copied.
ctr.overPlan: This project's plan runs fewer containers than it has, so this one is stopped. It is kept as it was, and runs again if the plan allows it.
ctr.paidOnly: Containers run on every paid plan (Plus, Pro and Business), because a container runs all the time. Change this project's plan on the dashboard to deploy one.
ctr.rebuildHint: Start this build again from scratch
ctr.reresolveHint: Resolve the tag again and run what it points at now
ctr.tokenHint: The token is stored sealed and used only to pull. A redeploy of the same image reuses it.

delete.body: The project and its data are deleted. It can be restored for your plan's grace period.
delete.confirm: The project {ref} and its data are deleted. It can be restored for your plan's grace period. Its connection is removed from your list.
delete.title: Delete this project

domains.added: {host} added. Publish its records, then verify.
domains.intro: Serve this project's API at your own domain, with a certificate we obtain and renew. Paid plans only.
domains.title: Your domains

fn.none: No functions deployed. Deploy one with `snoutdata functions deploy <name>`.
fn.secretSet: {name} set. Functions see it on their next start.
fn.secretsIntro: Environment variables for your functions. A value goes in and never comes back out: only the names are listed.
fn.servedAt: Served at `https://{ref}.api.snoutdata.com{prefix}/<name>`. Deploy with the CLI.
fn.sized: {name} runs at {mb} MB × {workers} from its next request.
fn.sizingIntro: On the {tier} plan a worker may use up to {memory} MB and a function may run up to {max} workers at once. Memory × workers may not exceed this project's {pod} MB, the RAM its database gets. A function gets a second worker only while every worker it has is busy on CPU; requests that wait on the network share one.

maint.crossMidnight: Runs across midnight, {start} to {end} the next day.
maint.intro: The hours when this database may be moved to another server while it runs. By default, 2 to 6 AM in the owner's timezone.
maint.pickEnd: Pick an end hour different from the start.
maint.title: Maintenance window

status.cold: Its data is in the bucket rather than on a host, so the next start is a restore and takes longer.

svc.authHint: Sign-up and sign-in for your app's users, with the project's own keys. Your users live in the auth schema of your database.
svc.dataHint: REST and GraphQL over your tables (PostgREST and pg_graphql), for @snoutdata/client or any client that speaks PostgREST.
svc.dataNotPlan: The data API is not included in this project's plan.
svc.providers: Providers are set up in the dashboard.
svc.pushHint: Notifications to iPhone, Android and the web. It runs beside your database, and its devices, log and keys stay in your database's push schema. Turning it on restarts the database once.
svc.pushKeys: Apple and Firebase keys are set in the dashboard, or with `snoutdata push credentials`. They are checked, then kept in your own database.
svc.storageHint: Files for your app, stored in your project's storage.
svc.turnedOn: Turned on. It starts on the project's next restart, within a minute.
svc.waitingHost: Waiting for the host to register it

tz.ownerAccount: The owner's, set on their account
tz.ownerSignIn: The owner's, from their last sign-in

usage.none: Nothing measured yet. The host samples every 15 minutes.
